items.summary: Upstream GPUBucketsObj::add2Bucket passes MAX_CNT_PER_BKT_ (not MAX_CNT_PER_BKT_-1) to atomicInc, so the 111th insert into a bucket returns 110 and writes slot 0 of the next bucket; for the last bucket that is one uint past the data_ allocation. Pre-existing in ReconstructorCUDA.cuh, out of scope for the HIP port; raise with the maintainers.
